name: Café Rouge
source:
Isis, your average American teenager, happens upon a part time job opening at Café Rouge. During the day, it is a normal, quaint café and bakery. But when night takes over, it is transformed into a five star restaurant-theater-café, with live stage performances and first class customers arriving in the middle of the night.

As Isis delves deeper into this strange café, she becomes entangled in the mystery of its’ haunted world. Will she find friends, or enemies? Will she follow fate or make her own destiny? Will she find love?

[From [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/29222564801/cafe-rouge-isis-your-average-american-teenager]English Otome Games[/url]]
translation:
伊希丝是一名普通的美国少女，偶然发现 Café Rouge 正在招聘兼职。

白天，这里是一家普通而别致的咖啡馆兼面包店。到了夜晚，它会变成五星级餐厅、剧院和咖啡馆，提供现场舞台表演，深夜还会迎来一流客人。

随着伊希丝逐渐深入这家奇怪的咖啡馆，她被卷入了这个闹鬼世界的谜团。她会找到朋友，还是敌人？她会顺从命运，还是创造自己的未来？她能找到爱情吗？

[来自 [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/29222564801/cafe-rouge-isis-your-average-american-teenager]English Otome Games[/url]]
